## Extend a Clip: MiniMax H3 Max

**Keep the shot rolling.** Extend continues a finished clip with new footage the model generates from your prompt, so a 5 second ad becomes a 10 second one without a second shoot and without a cut. The source clip is the reference for lighting, wardrobe, framing and motion.

---

### What this graph does

1. **Load Video**: the source clip. 1.625 to 60 seconds, up to 50 MB, aspect ratio between 0.4 and 2.5.
2. **MiniMax H3 Max Extend Video**: generates `duration` seconds of new footage that continues the clip, guided by `prompt`.
3. **Save Video**: writes the MP4.

**Input Assets:** [api_minimax_h3_max_extend_input.mp4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/api_minimax_h3_max_extend_input.mp4) — 1280 x 720, 5.04 seconds at 24 fps.

---

### Writing the prompt

Describe **what happens next**, not what is already in the clip. The model can see the source, so repeating the wardrobe or the room wastes the prompt; name the new action, the new camera move and what has to stay the same.

- `She keeps the lipstick raised, turns the tube slowly so the label catches the light, then lowers it and leans toward the lens with a small smile; the camera drifts a few centimetres closer...`
- A walk-out: `She sets the cup down, picks up her bag and walks out of frame right; the camera holds, the same room stays lit the same way.`

---

### Controls

| Control | What it does |
|---|---|
| `model` | `MiniMax H3 Max` or `MiniMax H3 Max Turbo` |
| `prompt` | What happens in the new footage |
| `duration` | Seconds of new footage to add, 1 to 15, default 5 |
| `resolution` | `480P`, `768P`, `1080P` or `2K`, default `768P` |
| `aspect_ratio` | `auto` follows the source; other values crop to the chosen ratio |
| `output` | `extended` returns the whole clip re-rendered plus the new footage; `continuation` returns only the new footage, opening with a 1.6 second repeat of the source ending |
| `prompt_expansion` | Rewrites the prompt against the source video for consistency; turn it off for reproducible seeds |
| `seed` | Same prompt and seed give similar, not identical, results |
| `reference_audios` | Optional audio references for the new footage, `@Audio1` to `@Audio3`, at least 2 seconds each and 14.5 seconds in total |

The optional `reference_audios` sockets are on the node but not wired in this graph. Add a **Load Audio** node and connect it to `reference_audios.audio_1` when the continuation needs to match a voice or a music bed, then refer to it in the prompt as `@Audio1`.

---

### Gotchas

- `extended` re-renders the whole clip at the chosen `resolution`, so a 5.04 second source plus 5 seconds of new footage comes back as roughly 10 seconds at 768P. Budget for the full length, not just the added seconds.
- `continuation` does not give you a clean join on its own: it starts with a 1.6 second repeat of the source ending, which you trim or cross-fade in an editor.
- The source must be at least 1.625 seconds long. Shorter clips are rejected before generation.
- Keep `prompt_expansion` on while you are still exploring; turn it off once you have a prompt you want to reproduce with a fixed seed.
